basis: The company is an operator (16 CFR 312.2): a for-profit LLC operating an online service, the tutoring platform's student portal and online classroom, directed to children (K-12 tutoring; about 250 of about 420 students are under 13), that collects children's names, user names, voice and video in sessions and recordings, and work samples. No size exemption; 312.8(b) scales the written program to size. Compliance date for the 2025 amendments was April 22, 2026

Not an educational agency or institution: the company receives no funds under a Department of Education program (34 CFR 99.1). The district contract and data privacy agreement designate it a school official for the after-school program (99.31(a)(1)(i)(B)), subject to the redisclosure limits in 99.33(a)
Not a Title IV institution and no Program Participation Agreement; offers families no loans, payment plans or other financial products (families pay monthly in advance)
Not a covered entity: the company provides tutoring, not health care, and bills no health plans. Evaluation reports that parents share are held as tutoring records

Not a final rule. The proposed criteria reach education agencies with 1,000 or more students, Title IV institutions, and entities above the SBA size standard; the company is none of these (about $1.1 million in receipts against a $24.0 million standard)

The company holds personal information of Florida residents (families and students; online sessions are offered only to families with a Florida home address). Reasonable measures (2), breach notice (3)-(6), disposal (8)

obligation: District contract and data privacy agreement
basis: Signed contract: use only for the program; no redisclosure; reasonable safeguards; notice to the district within 48 hours of discovering unauthorized access; deletion within 60 days after the contract ends, with certification; district audit right

citation: Payment processor terms (through the scheduling platform)
basis: Card numbers are entered in the processor's hosted fields and are not stored by the company
